A run chase packed with power, precision and pure T10 entertainment!
Arabian Aces made a statement against Royal Desert Champions, chasing down 113 in just 9 overs to secure a commanding nine-wicket win!
Paul Walter led the charge with an explosive unbeaten 62 off 26 balls, while Tom Kohler-Cadmore added a quickfire 42. Earlier, Philip Salt's 55 had helped Royal Desert Champions post 112/6.
